summary.text: Harold Jones II, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia Senate in 2014 and represents District 22, which includes portions of Richmond County; the legislature biography says he was elected Senate Democratic Leader in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jones was elected Solicitor General of Richmond County in 2004, the first African American to hold the office, and was re-elected in 2008.
Jones earned a bachelor's degree from South Carolina State University in 1991 and graduated from North Carolina Central University Law School in 1994.
